column4: AS-IS wraps the class in a block-scoped `namespace DCGO.CardEffects.BT17 { }` with usings `System.Collections.Generic`, `System`, `System.Linq`; TO-BE uses a file-scoped `namespace HeadlessDCGO.Engine.Assets.Scripts.CardEffect.BT17.Blue;` with different usings (`System.Threading.Tasks`, `...Script`, `...CardEffectCommons`, `...CardEffects`, `...Headless.Services`) and drops the explicit `System`/`System.Collections.Generic`/`System.Linq` usings

AS-IS calls `permanent.TopCard.Owner.GetBattleAreaPermanents()` directly on Owner (AS-IS `CardSource.Owner` is type `Player`, CardSource.cs:25); TO-BE wraps it as `new Player(card.Context, permanent.TopCard.Owner).GetBattleAreaPermanents()` because TO-BE's `CardSource.Owner` is `HeadlessPlayerId` (CardSource.cs:41), not a Player instance

Same Owner-type substrate wrap as above applied to `card.Owner.HandCards.Contains(card)` (:90/:92) and `card.Owner.GetBattleAreaPermanents().Count(...)` (:92/:94), each becoming `new Player(card.Context, card.Owner).HandCards...` / `...GetBattleAreaPermanents()...`

AS-IS declares `IEnumerator ActivateCoroutine(Hashtable hashtable)`, driven throughout via `yield return ContinuousController.instance.StartCoroutine(...)`; TO-BE declares `async Task ActivateCoroutine(Hashtable hashtable)`, driven via `await`

Same Owner->Player substrate wrap recurs for `card.Owner.HandCards.Contains(card)` (:111/:113), `card.Owner.GetBattleAreaPermanents()` (:113/:115 and :118/:120), `card.Owner.TrashCards.Count(...)` (:158/:160 and :163/:165), and `card.Owner.GetBattleAreaPermanents().Contains(selectedPermanent)` inside CanUseChangeColorCondition (:285/:286)
`Permanent selectedPermanent = null;` becomes `Permanent? selectedPermanent = null;` (nullable-reference-type annotation added)

`IEnumerator SelectPermanentCoroutine(Permanent permanent) { selectedPermanent = permanent; yield return null; }` becomes `Task SelectPermanentCoroutine(Permanent permanent) { selectedPermanent = permanent; return Task.CompletedTask; }`

`IEnumerator SelectCardCoroutine(CardSource cardSource) { selectedCards.Add(cardSource); yield return null; }` becomes `Task SelectCardCoroutine(CardSource cardSource) { selectedCards.Add(cardSource); return Task.CompletedTask; }`

AS-IS passes the `ICardEffect activateClass` itself as the 2nd argument, `AddDigivolutionCardsBottom(selectedCards, activateClass)` (AS-IS `Permanent.AddDigivolutionCardsBottom(List<CardSource>, ICardEffect cardEffect, ...)`, Permanent.cs:1133); TO-BE passes `activateClass.EffectSourceCard?.InstanceId` because TO-BE's `Permanent.AddDigivolutionCardsBottom` takes `HeadlessEntityId? causeEffectSourceId` instead of `ICardEffect` (Permanent.cs:3884-3886)

AS-IS gates the digivolution attempt on `card.CanPlayCardTargetFrame(selectedPermanent.PermanentFrame, true, activateClass)`; TO-BE gates it on `selectedPermanent.TopCard.Owner == card.Owner && card.CanEvolve(selectedPermanent, true)` instead. Both `CanPlayCardTargetFrame` (CardSource.cs:447) and `CanEvolve` (CardSource.cs:2092) exist in TO-BE and are both still used elsewhere in the ported tree (e.g. BT13_028.cs:204 calls `CanPlayCardTargetFrame` the same way AS-IS does here), so the substitution is not forced by a missing symbol

AS-IS passes `failedProcess: DigivolvedFailed()` -- invoking the local `IEnumerator DigivolvedFailed()` to obtain an enumerator instance (AS-IS overload param `IEnumerator failedProcess`, CardEffectCommons.cs:769); TO-BE passes `failedProcess: DigivolvedFailed` -- a method-group reference, not a call, matching TO-BE's overload `Func<Task> failedProcess` (CardEffectCommons.cs:2266)

AS-IS's else branch is `yield return ContinuousController.instance.StartCoroutine("DigivolvedFailed");` -- starting a coroutine by string name, which Unity resolves as a method on the `ContinuousController` MonoBehaviour itself, not the local function `DigivolvedFailed`; TO-BE's else branch is `await DigivolvedFailed();`, directly invoking the local function

AS-IS: `IEnumerator DigivolvedFailed() { IDiscardHand discard = new IDiscardHand(card, hashtable); discard.Discard(); yield return null; }` -- `discard.Discard()` returns an `IEnumerator` that is never enumerated (no `yield return` in front of it), so its body never runs. TO-BE: `async Task DigivolvedFailed() { await new IDiscardHand(card).Discard(null, activateClass.EffectSourceCard?.InstanceId); }` -- the `IDiscardHand` constructor drops the `hashtable` parameter and `Discard` now takes two new parameters (TO-BE `IDiscardHand` class, CardController.cs, ctor + `Discard(long? discardBatchId, HeadlessEntityId? causeEffectSourceId, ...)`), and the call is awaited so its body executes

`card.Owner.PermanentEffects.Add(getCardEffect)` (:370/:371) and its counterpart `card.Owner.PermanentEffects.Remove(getCardEffect)` (:405/:404) become `new Player(card.Context, card.Owner).PermanentEffects.Add(...)` / `.Remove(...)` -- same Owner-type substrate wrap as above

AS-IS gates the region labelled "When Digivolving" on `timing == EffectTiming.OnEnterFieldAnyone` -- AS-IS's `EffectTiming` enum (ICardEffect.cs:969-1035) has no `WhenDigivolving` member at all; the digivolving-specific case is distinguished only at runtime by `CanUseCondition`'s call to `CardEffectCommons.CanTriggerWhenDigivolving`. TO-BE gates the same region on `timing == EffectTiming.WhenDigivolving`, an enum member (ICardEffect.cs:1113) that has no counterpart anywhere in AS-IS's EffectTiming enum

`card.PermanentOfThisCard().DigivolutionCards.Count(...)` becomes `ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard(card).DigivolutionCards.Count(...)`. AS-IS `CardSource.PermanentOfThisCard()` returns `Permanent` (CardSource.cs:335); TO-BE's `CardSource.PermanentOfThisCard()` returns a different type, `PermanentView` (CardSource.cs:56), so the port must go through the static `ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard(CardSource)` helper (ICardEffect.cs:462) to obtain a `Permanent`
`IEnumerator ActivateCoroutine(Hashtable hashtable)` becomes `async Task ActivateCoroutine(Hashtable hashtable)`

`Permanent selectedPermanent = card.PermanentOfThisCard();` becomes `Permanent selectedPermanent = ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard(card);` -- same PermanentOfThisCard return-type substitution as above

`customRootCardList: selectedPermanent.DigivolutionCards` becomes `customRootCardList: selectedPermanent.DigivolutionCards.ToList()`. AS-IS `Permanent.DigivolutionCards` returns `List<CardSource>` (Permanent.cs:888 AS-IS); TO-BE `Permanent.DigivolutionCards` returns `IReadOnlyList<CardSource>` (Permanent.cs:1766 TO-BE), which needs `.ToList()` to satisfy the `List<CardSource> customRootCardList` parameter

AS-IS: `yield return StartCoroutine(selectCardEffect.Activate());` -- calls `StartCoroutine` without the `ContinuousController.instance.` prefix used everywhere else in this file; TO-BE: `await selectCardEffect.Activate();`

`CardEffectCommons.MatchConditionPermanentCount(CanSelectOpponentPermanentCondition)` (AS-IS signature has no `card` parameter, CardEffectCommons/GameContextDeterminarion.cs:601) becomes `CardEffectCommons.MatchConditionPermanentCount(card, CanSelectOpponentPermanentCondition)` (TO-BE requires a leading `CardSource card` parameter, CardEffectCommons.cs)

AS-IS's `IEnumerator SelectPermanentCoroutine(Permanent permanent)`, after adding `canNotSuspendClass` to `UntilOwnerTurnEndEffects`, runs `if (!selectedPermanent.TopCard.CanNotBeAffected(activateClass)) { yield return ContinuousController.instance.StartCoroutine(GManager.instance.GetComponent<Effects>().CreateDebuffEffect(selectedPermanent)); }` before the nested condition functions. TO-BE's `Task SelectPermanentCoroutine(Permanent permanent)` returns `Task.CompletedTask` immediately after `UntilOwnerTurnEndEffects.Add(...)` -- the entire `CanNotBeAffected`/`CreateDebuffEffect` block is absent. TO-BE does have a working `Effects.CreateDebuffEffect(Permanent)` (Effects.cs:136, a no-op stub returning `Task.CompletedTask`), so its omission here is not forced by a missing symbol

`card.PermanentOfThisCard().TopCard.ContainsTraits("Hybrid"/"Ten Warriors"/"TenWarriors")` (3 calls, :604-606) become `ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard(card).TopCard.ContainsTraits(...)` (3 calls, :599-601) -- same PermanentOfThisCard return-type substitution as above
`IEnumerator ActivateCoroutine(Hashtable hashtable)` becomes `async Task ActivateCoroutine(Hashtable hashtable)`

`CardEffectCommons.HasMatchConditionPermanent(CanSelectPermanentCondition)` (:617) and `MatchConditionPermanentCount(CanSelectPermanentCondition)` (:619) -- AS-IS signatures take no `card` parameter (CardEffectCommons/GameContextDeterminarion.cs:641,601) -- become `HasMatchConditionPermanent(card, CanSelectPermanentCondition)` (:612) and `MatchConditionPermanentCount(card, CanSelectPermanentCondition)` (:614), TO-BE requiring a leading `card` parameter
`yield return ContinuousController.instance.StartCoroutine(selectPermanentEffect.Activate());` becomes `await selectPermanentEffect.Activate();`
